>>> Light **both ends of the first rope** and **one end of the second rope** at the same time.  
>>> The first rope will burn completely in **30 minutes** (since burning from both ends doubles the burning rate).  
>>> At the moment the first rope is fully burned (after 30 minutes), **light the other end of the second rope**.
